question: Within the 2015 dataset for accidents that occurred from January through August and involved more than one distinct person, what percentage of these accidents had more than one individual with a severe injury (injury severity = 4)
sql:
SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN severe_injury_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    COUNT(*)
  ) * 100 as percentage
FROM (
  SELECT 
    a.state_number,
    a.consecutive_number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_number) as distinct_persons,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.injury_severity = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as severe_injury_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2015` a
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.person_2015` p 
    ON a.state_number = p.state_number AND a.consecutive_number = p.consecutive_number
  WHERE a.month_of_crash BETWEEN 1 AND 8
  GROUP BY a.state_number, a.consecutive_number
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_number) > 1
)
